$comment: The release evidence gate's configuration, read at the release commit by scripts/dev/release_evidence.py
(from judgment-pack-devkit; docs/releasing.md). The release takes main's evidence for the checks that read
the commit's tree alone. The entries tests read the tags and the release history, which the release's tag
changes, so the evidence leaves them out and the release runs them at the tag (ci.yml HISTORY_CHECKS).
fresh_at_release: entries: the tests, which read the tags, the release history and the specification at the pin, run at the tag (CI at the tag)
tag grammar, tag names the commit, commit on main

linux.$comment: The release's evidence job sets up Python as ci.yml does, and resolves the same image and tools.
